statement: Google Cloud revenue grew 82% year-over-year to $24.8 billion in 2Q26, accelerating from 63% in Q1 2026 and 48% in Q4 2025, with cloud operating income of $8.8 billion versus $2.8 billion a year earlier.
why: Accelerating cloud revenue with sharply higher operating income shows AI infrastructure spending is being monetized, which supports continued willingness to buy accelerators rather than pause.

impact.mechanism: Cloud growth accelerating across three consecutive quarters alongside expanding operating income funds and justifies further accelerator and data-center purchases.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance (Bloomberg wire) — "Google increases capex forecast again after cloud-driven earnings beat"
